name: Cloth Robe
description: Simple cloth robes. Offer minimal protection but don't hinder movement.

name: Leather Armor
description: Cured leather armor, offering a balance of protection and mobility.
flavor_text: The favored second skin of those who survive.

name: Iron Plate
description: Heavy iron plate armor. You won't be sneaking anywhere in this.
flavor_text: Every dent is a story of survival.

name: Traveler's Cloak
description: A worn but functional travelling cloak. Provides basic protection and warmth.

name: Mage Robes
description: Robes woven with mana-reactive thread. Light and flexible, enhancing focus and arcane sensitivity.
flavor_text: Comfort is a form of power.
backstory: Standard issue for licensed arcane practitioners before the Fracture disrupted the Mages' Accord. Most were destroyed. These survived.
